label: G-010S-A GPON SFP ONT
description: Nokia G-010S-A GPON ONT in SFP form factor (Lantiq PEB98035): one SC/UPC angled-free GPON port (2.488/1.244 Gbit/s) and an HSGMII host interface on the SFP edge connector, with no RJ45 and no Wi-Fi. It is the SC/UPC sibling of the SC/APC G-010S-P and is managed by OMCI or its own CLI.
